errors.AUTH_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.ADMIN_CANNOT_DELETE_SELF: You cannot delete your own account
errors.ADMIN_CANNOT_RESET_OWN_PASSWORD: You cannot reset your own password here
errors.KOMGA_HTTP_ERROR: HTTP error while communicating with Komga
errors.KOMGA_UNAUTHORIZED: Komga credentials invalid (HTTP 401). Update the username or password in your connections.
errors.KOMGA_FORBIDDEN: Komga access denied (HTTP 403). Check your account permissions.
errors.KOMGA_NOT_FOUND: Komga resource not found (HTTP 404). The server URL might be wrong.
errors.KOMGA_SERVER_ERROR: Komga server issue (HTTP 5xx). Try again later.
errors.STRIPSTREAM_HTTP_ERROR: HTTP error while communicating with Stripstream Librarian
errors.STRIPSTREAM_UNAUTHORIZED: Stripstream token invalid or expired (HTTP 401). Update the token in your connections.
errors.STRIPSTREAM_FORBIDDEN: Stripstream access denied (HTTP 403). Check the token's permissions.
errors.STRIPSTREAM_NOT_FOUND: Stripstream resource not found (HTTP 404). The server URL might be wrong.
errors.STRIPSTREAM_SERVER_ERROR: Stripstream server issue (HTTP 5xx). Try again later.
errors.CONFIG_INVALID_URL: Invalid server URL. Use an http(s) URL without credentials, query string or metadata endpoint.

errors.CREDENTIALS_INVALID_ENCRYPTION_KEY: CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is invalid: expected 32 bytes in base64 (openssl rand -base64 32) or 64 hex characters.
errors.CREDENTIALS_DECRYPT_ERROR: Unable to decrypt stored provider credentials. Check that CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY matches the key used to encrypt them.
errors.SERIES_RATING_NOT_SUPPORTED: Series rating is not available with this provider
errors.WALL_FETCH_ERROR: Could not gather the works for the wall. Check your connection and try again.
